title: Shared design-token change
summary: Trials a violet brand by changing two primitive blue tokens. Every semantic token built on them changes too, restyling primary actions, links, focus rings and info badges everywhere.
whyItMatters: A two-line diff with application-wide effects. Design Warden follows the aliases, lists every affected token and usage, and (with visual capture) the changed screens, so owners can review the blast radius.
